tech.detail: 2741 link annotations for 2513 links in the source

coverage.note: Book page has title, author, genre, format, started/finished, pages, stars, reread, why, thoughts, favorite quote + page, character, one-line review; quotes page seen; notes pages exist in page_modules only (not screenshotted).
Title names Goodnotes as the first app; description and Start here list Goodnotes, Notability, Samsung Notes, Xodo, Noteshelf on iPad, Android and Windows tablets; one PDF.
Library book log, TBR list, 12 monthly pages and Reading year goal page all present.
Contents page, 12 month tabs and Home/Library/TBR/Quotes bar link on every page; b002-b099 have prev+next arrows, b001 next only, b100 prev only; 0 broken links, 0 unreachable pages.
Consistent cards, spacing and Baskerville/Manrope type throughout; looks finished.
Start here (4 steps, tip) and Setup check (buttons, fix list) are printed in the file.

One PDF (no zip, no stickers) and photo 4 + description give the 3 download steps, Start here repeats them; BUT the cover title 'Shelf Life' does not appear anywhere in the listing title, so cover and listing title do not match.
Open journal links to Start here (p3), Setup check is p4 and both are the first Contents cards; but step 1 has no Go there button (only steps 2-4 do), so not 'each with a Go there button'.

Pages 576x768 pt (768x1024 px) portrait, plain GoTo links, Works with list, not for phones, not a fillable form, Setup check present; but no 'not a spreadsheet' line and no distinct Works with / Not for box.
100 numbered book pages, 12 undated months, TBR; description lists each page type with counts.
One book layout; Library numbers link to b001-b100, trail 'Library' returns to the right Library page; Start here step 3 describes exactly this.
No misspellings in extracted text, 0 broken links, 0 unreachable pages, no overflow seen, text is vector (extractable), book pages 1-100 in order once each.

Photos 2 and 3 are captioned 'B001' (internal id, not a page name); photo 4 alt/points claim an apps/tablets/not-for-phones panel that is not in the image; description never says it is printable at home.
100 books, 12 months, year, TBR, quotes, notes and 126-page count are all there; but photo 2 ('Book page, real size') shows the whole page shrunk to about half the photo height, not real size.

Blank Shelf column, write-in Genre, undated months, typing tip and not-a-fillable-form are present; but Format is a fixed Print/Ebook/Audio choice, not write-in, while the listing says format is written in by you.
Three buttons (month page, year, Contents) and a 4-item fix list: pen off, open in an app not Files/Photos, re-import as PDF, message the shop.

FAQ covers Etsy app download, which app, links not tapping, how to type; the fifth answer is 'look up my books', not 'portrait only' (portrait is only in Good to know). No reply-time promises (r007 ok).
No stickers or covers advertised; counts match the file (126 pages, 2.86 MB = 2,864,836 bytes); Contents shows every section on one screen.
4 Library pages x 25 numbered lines with title/author/finished/stars/shelf; numbers link to book pages, trail returns to the matching Library page (b100 -> library4), arrows step prev/next.
Start here is page 3, Setup check page 4, cover button lands on Start here, buttons jump with return instructions and a fix list; note step 1 has no Go there button.
Goal line, 12 month rows of squares with each month name linked to its page, fiction/nonfiction and print/ebook/audio tallies, top 5 of the year.

Ivory paper, ink-blue text, brass strip, clay-to-blue month tabs with dark labels, Libre Baskerville + Manrope, ruled lines, no florals all present; but there is no oxblood accent in the file: buttons and star outlines are ink navy.

visual.issue: Listing says genre and format are written in by you, but the book page has fixed Print / Ebook / Audio choices for format.
Photo 4 alt text and points describe a panel of note apps, tablets and 'Not for phones. Not a fillable form', but the photo shows only the Start here page and 3 download steps (r005).
TBR 'Got it' column has no boxes and the table has no column dividers, so it is just ruled lines; the listing promises a Got it box.
Cover title 'Shelf Life' does not appear in the listing title, so a buyer cannot match the file to what they bought.
Photos 2, 3, 5, 6 and 7 show whole pages shrunk to fit, so field labels are tiny at Etsy's zoom (r013); photo 2 is labelled 'real size' but is not.
Photos 2 and 3 caption the book page 'B001', an internal anchor id rather than a page name.
Start here step 1 has no Go there button, and all four step cards leave a large empty lower half.
No oxblood accent anywhere in the file; buttons and stars are navy, so the look is flatter than the brief.
Brass strip sits flush at the top edge of the cover, Contents and Start here, so it looks clipped or misplaced.
The Contents Notes card sits alone, leaving two empty card slots in the grid.
The eyebrow 'SETUP CHECK' repeats the title 'Setup check'.
Setup check fix list says 'PDF planner app' while everywhere else says note app; Start here top-bar map omits HOME.
The J of January and July hangs past the left text margin.
Year page has only 10 squares a month and month pages 8 book lines, which caps heavy readers with no note on where it stops (r011).
The Quotes and TBR pages are almost entirely blank ruled lines, with no fields for book or page number.
In photo 1 the back tablet shows clipped fragments of Book 1 ('dio', 'lo'), and the only caption is 'COVER'.
The two-tablet photos leave a large empty gap in the middle; in photo 6 the third bullet wraps to its own row.
The description never says the file is printable at home, though the brief promised it would.
